understanding the role of LRRK kinase pathway in Parkinson9s and developing assays to interrogate this pathway in human samples.
the development of novel tools to facilitate LRRK2 drug discovery and to enable clinical translation of LRRK inhibitors.
the identification, development and validation of novel biomarkers for Parkinson9s disease, and in particular for LRRK kinase activity.
